targets.rawSql:
WITH TimeSpine AS (
  -- 1. Create the timeline, but SNAP it to the exact same boundaries as the data
  SELECT DISTINCT $__timeGroup(series_time, '$__interval') AS time_bucket
  FROM generate_series(
    $__timeFrom()::timestamptz, 
    $__timeTo()::timestamptz, 
    '$__interval'::interval
  ) AS series_time
),
Traffic AS (
  -- 2. Grab your actual packet data, snapped to the same boundaries
  SELECT
    $__timeGroup(m.time, '$__interval') AS time_bucket,
    m.portnum AS metric,
    COUNT(DISTINCT m.packet_id) AS unique_messages
  FROM mesh_packet_metrics m
  LEFT JOIN node_details gn ON REPLACE(m.reporting_gateway::text, '!', '') = REPLACE(gn.node_id::text, '!', '')
  WHERE $__timeFilter(m.time)
    AND m.portnum IN (${message_type:singlequote})
    AND TRIM(REPLACE(substring(gn.last_heard_topic from '^msh/(.*?)/2/[ce]/'), 'US/AZ/', '')) IN (${mqtt_region:singlequote})
    -- 📍 Extracts the second-to-last segment (the channel name before the Node ID)
    AND substring(gn.last_heard_topic from '/([^/]+)/[^/]+$') IN (${channel:singlequote})
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)

-- 3. Staple them together!
SELECT 
  ts.time_bucket AS "time",
  COALESCE(t.metric, 'Network Quiet') AS metric,
  COALESCE(t.unique_messages, 0) AS "Unique Messages"
FROM TimeSpine ts
LEFT JOIN Traffic t ON ts.time_bucket = t.time_bucket
ORDER BY ts.time_bucket ASC;

WITH ActiveGateways AS (
  -- 1. Calculate the Theoretical Max for the selected region(s)
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT REPLACE(m.reporting_gateway::text, '!', '')) AS total_active_gws
  FROM mesh_packet_metrics m
  LEFT JOIN node_details gn ON REPLACE(m.reporting_gateway::text, '!', '') = REPLACE(gn.node_id::text, '!', '')
  WHERE $__timeFilter(m.time)
    AND TRIM(REPLACE(substring(gn.last_heard_topic from '^msh/(.*?)/2/[ce]/'), 'US/AZ/', '')) IN (${mqtt_region:singlequote})
),
PacketScores AS (
  -- 2. Grade Every Packet (Respecting the exact same region filter)
  SELECT
    REPLACE(m.source_id::text, '!', '') AS sender_id,
    m.packet_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT REPLACE(m.reporting_gateway::text, '!', '')) AS gateways_hit
  FROM mesh_packet_metrics m
  LEFT JOIN node_details gn ON REPLACE(m.reporting_gateway::text, '!', '') = REPLACE(gn.node_id::text, '!', '')
  WHERE $__timeFilter(m.time)
    AND m.portnum IN (${message_type:singlequote})
    AND TRIM(REPLACE(substring(gn.last_heard_topic from '^msh/(.*?)/2/[ce]/'), 'US/AZ/', '')) IN (${mqtt_region:singlequote})
    -- 📍 Extracts the second-to-last segment (the channel name before the Node ID)
    AND substring(gn.last_heard_topic from '/([^/]+)/[^/]+$') IN (${channel:singlequote})
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
NodeAggregates AS (
  -- 3. Roll it up to the Node level
  SELECT
    sender_id,
    COUNT(packet_id) AS total_messages_sent,
    MAX(gateways_hit) AS best_packet_reach,
    ROUND(AVG(gateways_hit)::numeric, 1) AS avg_gateways_hit
  FROM PacketScores
  GROUP BY 1
)

-- ... (ActiveGateways, PacketScores, NodeAggregates CTEs stay the same) ...

-- 4. Final Output & Scoring
SELECT
  na.sender_id AS "raw_node_id", 
  COALESCE(n.long_name, na.sender_id) AS "Transmitting Node",
  na.total_messages_sent AS "Msgs Sent",
  na.avg_gateways_hit AS "Avg Gateways Hit",
  na.best_packet_reach AS "Best Reach",
  ag.total_active_gws AS "Active Network Size",
  ROUND((na.avg_gateways_hit / ag.total_active_gws) * 100, 1) AS "Propagation Score"

FROM NodeAggregates na
CROSS JOIN ActiveGateways ag
LEFT JOIN node_details n ON na.sender_id = REPLACE(n.node_id::text, '!', '')
WHERE ag.total_active_gws > 0 
  -- 📍 REMOVED: AND na.total_messages_sent >= 3 
ORDER BY "Propagation Score" DESC;

WITH ActiveGateways AS (
  -- Calculate the Theoretical Max so we have a true 100% baseline
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT REPLACE(m.reporting_gateway::text, '!', '')) AS total_active_gws
  FROM mesh_packet_metrics m
  LEFT JOIN node_details gn ON REPLACE(m.reporting_gateway::text, '!', '') = REPLACE(gn.node_id::text, '!', '')
  WHERE $__timeFilter(m.time)
    AND TRIM(REPLACE(substring(gn.last_heard_topic from '^msh/(.*?)/2/[ce]/'), 'US/AZ/', '')) IN (${mqtt_region:singlequote})
)
SELECT
  MIN(m.time) AS "Time Sent",
  m.portnum AS "App Type",
  m.packet_id::text AS "Packet ID",
  
  -- The Raw Count
  COUNT(DISTINCT REPLACE(m.reporting_gateway::text, '!', '')) AS "Gateways Hit",
  
  -- 📍 The new Percentage Column for your Bar Gauge
  ROUND((COUNT(DISTINCT REPLACE(m.reporting_gateway::text, '!', ''))::numeric / 
    NULLIF((SELECT total_active_gws FROM ActiveGateways), 0)) * 100, 1) AS "Mesh Reach %",
  
  MIN(m.hop_start - m.hop_limit) AS "Closest Gateway (Hops)",
  MAX(m.rx_snr) AS "Best SNR",
  STRING_AGG(DISTINCT COALESCE(gn.long_name, REPLACE(m.reporting_gateway::text, '!', '')), ', ') AS "Reporting Gateways"

FROM mesh_packet_metrics m
LEFT JOIN node_details gn ON REPLACE(m.reporting_gateway::text, '!', '') = REPLACE(gn.node_id::text, '!', '')
WHERE $__timeFilter(m.time)
  AND REPLACE(m.source_id::text, '!', '') IN (${node_id:singlequote})
  AND m.portnum IN (${message_type:singlequote})
  AND TRIM(REPLACE(substring(gn.last_heard_topic from '^msh/(.*?)/2/[ce]/'), 'US/AZ/', '')) IN (${mqtt_region:singlequote})
  AND substring(gn.last_heard_topic from '/([^/]+)/[^/]+$') IN (${channel:singlequote})
GROUP BY m.packet_id, m.portnum
ORDER BY "Time Sent" DESC;

list.definition:
SELECT DISTINCT portnum 
FROM mesh_packet_metrics 
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
  AND portnum IS NOT NULL 
  AND portnum != ''
ORDER BY portnum ASC;
